breaking_news.headline: Why gold prices are surprisingly low
breaking_news.summary: Gold tends to go up when there's uncertainty in the economy. For a while, the price reflected that. But this week, it dropped from a nearly $5,600 in January to below $4,000. What's going on?

breaking_news.headline: Hiring jumps: The economy added 165,000 jobs last month
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday.  Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.

breaking_news.headline: This was the week the AI trade cracked. So what's next?
breaking_news.summary: Big losses by AI shares in stock markets after Democrats won the midterm elections have left investors shaken and wondering comes next.

breaking_news.headline: The Cybertruck's 'cause of death?' Insufficient demand
breaking_news.summary: One of the most polarizing vehicles to hit the road will soon be a thing of history. Tesla will wind down manufacturing of its Cybertruck at the company's Gigafactory Texas mid-next year.

breaking_news.headline: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
breaking_news.summary: Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.

breaking_news.headline: The business of El Niño
breaking_news.summary: El Niño is expected to bring wild weather, but it's also business opportunity for some. Contractors are booked up as homeowners prepare for heavy rains and ski resorts gear up to cash in on snow.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia shares tumble as the company says it's investigating CEO Jensen Huang
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia's share price falls after the company begins an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

breaking_news.headline: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
breaking_news.summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli forces kill Palestinian boy in West Bank, health ministry says
breaking_news.summary: The Israeli military says its soldiers opened fire at individuals “who intended to hurl stones” at a road used by Israelis.

breaking_news.headline: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
breaking_news.summary: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process next year.

breaking_news.headline: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo
breaking_news.summary: Officers attended the scene in connection with a separate incident at a residential building in the city.

breaking_news.headline: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards'
breaking_news.summary: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.

breaking_news.headline: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore
breaking_news.summary: The Odyssey was meant to take guests around the world for years, but the trip was cut short after its operator ran out of money.

breaking_news.headline: 'There is no justice' - Epstein survivor on how model agency sent her to abuser's home
breaking_news.summary: A woman says an agency boss sent her to photoshoots at the sex offender's Florida beach home.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
breaking_news.summary: Kyiv, Washington and Moscow have all sent delegations to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
breaking_news.summary: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.

breaking_news.headline: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
breaking_news.summary: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

breaking_news.headline: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
